title: The Cutting Edge: Week of September 6th
body:
**Highlights**
- The long awaiting [Partners’ Page](https://edgewa.re/partners) is now live.
- Edgscan, the Edgeware EVM explorer got yet another [update including contract verification and a brand new theme](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1437776158251266049?s=20).
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-dev-digest-sep-5/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Common Protocol partnered with [StaFi Protocol](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1435572623363252224?s=20).
- Denis Jazbec from 4thTech talked about data decentralization and data privacy in the [Blockchain Recorded Podcast](https://twitter.com/recordedpodcast/status/1436053618579345412?s=20).


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
- Recent/trending Community Research thread(s):
- [[Upgrade] Final Check for Wako Upgrade Push](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1453-upgrade-final-check-for-wako-upgrade-push)
- [EVM Benchmarks](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1793-evm-benchmarks)
